description: This file defines the ResourceKey interface in the org.eclipse.ditto.model.policies package. It provides methods for creating and interacting with resource keys that have a resource type and path, including static factory methods and methods to retrieve resource type and path information.

classes.name: ResourceKey
classes.description: An interface representing a resource's key, providing methods to obtain resource type, path, and field definitions.

methods.name: newInstance(CharSequence typeWithPath)
methods.description: Creates a ResourceKey from a character sequence containing a resource type and path separated by a colon.

methods.name: newInstance(CharSequence type, CharSequence path)
methods.description: Creates a ResourceKey from a resource type and path.

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Returns the resource type as a String.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the resource path as a JsonPointer.

methods.name: getJsonFieldDefinition
methods.description: Returns the JSON field definition for this resource key, default implementation provided.
